title: List of Defeated Kings

questions.question: How many kings in all did Joshua and Israel defeat west of the Jordan?
Who were the two kings defeated east of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:1-4 lists Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Bashan.

questions.question: Who defeated Sihon and Og?
options: Moses the servant of the Lord and the people of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Moses the servant of the Lord and the people of Israel
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:6 (ESV): "Moses the servant of the Lord and the people of Israel defeated them..."

questions.question: Who received the land east of the Jordan?
options: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:6 (ESV): "...given it for a possession to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh."

questions.question: The list of kings includes the king of Jericho and the king of Ai. Which is mentioned first?
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:9 (ESV): "the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai... one..."

questions.question: Where did Og reign?
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:4 (ESV): "and Og king of Bashan... who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei."

questions.question: Sihon king of the Amorites reigned in which city?
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:2 (ESV): "Sihon king of the Amorites who lived at Heshbon..."

questions.question: What body of water is known as the Sea of Chinneroth?
questions.explanation: Chinneroth is the biblical name for the Sea of Galilee.

questions.question: The territory west of Jordan is described as from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to where?
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:7 (ESV): "...from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak..."

questions.question: Which king of Jerusalem is listed?
Is the king of Bethel listed separately from Ai?
Which obscure "king of nations" is mentioned?
options: The king of Goiim in Gilgal
questions.correctAnswer: The king of Goiim in Gilgal
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:23 (ESV): "...the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one..." (ESV says "king of nations in Gilgal" or Goiim)

questions.question: Where was Mount Halak located?
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:7 (ESV): "...Mount Halak, that rises toward Seir..."

questions.question: The Geshurites and the Maacathites border whose territory?
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:5 (ESV): "...and ruled over... the boundary of the Geshurites and the Maacathites..."

questions.question: How is the land described regarding its terrain types in Verse 8?
options: The hill country, the lowland, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negeb
questions.correctAnswer: The hill country, the lowland, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negeb
questions.explanation: Joshua 12:8 (ESV): "in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Arabah, in the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the Negeb..."

key_verse_text: ...the king of Tirzah, one: in all, thirty-one kings. (ESV)
